A missing receiver triggers real script injection and one retry. A second missing receiver is classified as no-content-script, described in code as a likely manifest/runtime issue.

Prior feasibility diagnosis records NO_EXECUTABLE_NATIVE_PROCEDURE_YET and rejects mocks, injected exceptions, restricted pages, changed/closed tabs, and stale pages as proof of a real recoverable error.

A reproducible real browser condition that makes the product capture path return a recoverable error and render the actual Reload page control, without mocks or injected app state.
Retained native evidence identifying the actual error class and ordered user action, page reload, and successful subsequent capture.
Successful exact-current-main development artifact, then independent review and valid package/browser/guest resource finals before any T14 subtarget credit.
